title: Verified Zurich to London flight search

run.title: Search future flights
run.goal: Find one-way flights from Zurich to London on February 01, 2027, for one adult in economy. Stop when matching flight options are visible. Do not select or book a flight.

privacy_review: All flight frames and all scenario final frames were visually inspected; Google and Wikipedia are signed out, and support-form details are the declared synthetic example. No private traces or request bodies are included.
timing_note: Numeric frame timestamps are the original recorded post-action elapsed milliseconds. The final verification frame has no invented exact timestamp; it was captured after the agent loop and before browser closure.
